## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at Dôme des Invalides, 2 Place Vauban.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover AURA INVALIDES, the immersive experience at the heart of the Dôme des Invalides in Paris. A unique multimedia creation combining orchestral music, video mapping and lighting effects, the immersive AURA INVALIDES show sublimates the architecture of the famous Parisian monument.
>
> Offered exclusively in the evening, AURA INVALIDES invites visitors to (re)discover the exceptional heritage of the Dôme des Invalides - through an extraordinary experience!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €31.50. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 365 ratings and 156 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
